entities.summary: The International University of Sarajevo (IUS) is a private university located in the metropolitan area of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, within the municipality of Ilidža. The university was established by the Foundation for the Development of Education in 2004–2005. IUS is regarded as the most prestigious private university in the country based on its rankings.
